US Senator JD Vance criticizes H-1B visa program

US Senator JD Vance stated that the H-1B visa program should not be used to replace American workers with foreign labor. He argued that the program should instead be reserved for individuals with exceptional talent, referring to them as 'actual geniuses'. Vance expressed concern that the current system allows companies to hire foreign workers at lower wages, potentially displacing American employees. He emphasized that the intention of the H-1B visa should not be to facilitate the hiring of cheaper foreign labor over domestic workers.
